content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_ Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> call: • info • retry The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback.

When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData call: • info • retry The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData call- back.

When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData call: • info • retry The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData call- back.
